title: Underwater/Ocean
content: Apply underwater ocean aesthetic with aquatic immersion. Blue gradient depths: light surface to dark abyss. Bubble effects and particles. Marine life motifs: fish, coral, seaweed, shells. Flowing, fluid motion animations. Caustic light patterns (surface light refraction). Include wave and current effects. Translucent, layered elements. Peaceful, serene aquatic atmosphere. Deep sea wonder.

variants.simple: Create immersive underwater aesthetic with ocean blues, marine life, and aquatic depth.
variants.detailed: Apply underwater ocean aesthetic with aquatic immersion. Blue gradient depths: light surface to dark abyss. Bubble effects and particles. Marine life motifs: fish, coral, seaweed, shells. Flowing, fluid motion animations. Caustic light patterns (surface light refraction). Include wave and current effects. Translucent, layered elements. Peaceful, serene aquatic atmosphere. Deep sea wonder.
variants.advanced: Apply underwater ocean aesthetic with immersive aquatic depth. Color gradient: vertical gradient from light surface (#87ceeb, #00bcd4) to deep abyss (#0d1b2a, #1a237e), representing ocean zones. Bubbles: circular elements with gradient stroke (reflecting light), varying sizes, gentle upward float animation with wobble. Caustics: animated light patterns from surface refraction - SVG pattern with wave distortion, or CSS animation moving bright spots. Marine elements: fish silhouettes, coral formations, seaweed (SVG with gentle sway animation), jellyfish (translucent, pulsing), sea shells. Particles: tiny floating debris, plankton, adding atmosphere. Current effects: elements drift slightly, parallax suggesting water movement. Light rays: god rays streaming down from surface (gradient or SVG beams with animation). Depth layers: foreground elements darker/bluer than background (atmospheric perspective). Translucency: overlapping elements with backdrop-blur and transparency. Typography: flowing, rounded fonts suggesting water (Quicksand, Comfortaa). Sound visualization: wave forms, ripple effects. Interactive: bubbles rise from hover, fish swim away. Coral reef option: vibrant colors, busy with life. Deep sea option: bioluminescent glows in darkness, mysterious creatures. Implementation: layered CSS for depth, SVG for marine life, animations for immersion. Performance: particle systems need optimization. Accessibility: ensure text readable against gradient backgrounds.
